topic.source_contract: Local Plan transition, examination, soundness and housing-land-supply evidence

facts.change: new plan-making system introduced from March 2026
facts.guard: new-system guidance is not an adopted plan

facts.transition: legacy and new systems operate during 2026
facts.guard: route must be matched to submission date and regulations
submitted plan is not adopted policy

facts.evidence: site templates for allocations and five-year supply
facts.guard: template inclusion is not deliverability proof
authority-wide supply is not candidate allocation or permission

scope_guards: Legacy and new Local Plan systems operate during the 2026 transition; the applicable regulations and submission date must be checked.
A draft, publication or submitted plan is not an adopted development plan.
Independent examination tests legal compliance and soundness before adoption.
Positively prepared, justified, effective and consistent with national policy remain distinct soundness tests.
An allocation is not planning permission, title, infrastructure delivery or guaranteed development.
Five-year housing land supply is authority-wide evidence and not a candidate-specific deliverability finding.
Deliverable and developable site concepts, buffers and plan-period evidence require exact framework-version review.
No score or promotion is written without exact plan version, examination status, modifications, adoption, allocation and site evidence.
